settings.title: App Insights Settings
settings.description: Configure your refresh token to start tracking your Homey apps.
settings.need_help_finding_token: Need help finding your refresh token?
settings.token_step_login: Log in to tools.developer.homey.app with your Athom account.
settings.token_step_devtools: Open your browser's developer tools (F12) and go to the Application (Chrome) or Storage (Firefox) tab.
settings.token_step_localstorage: Under Local Storage, find the entry for tools.developer.homey.app and copy the value of refreshToken.
settings.token_step_paste: Paste it above and press Save.

errors.missing_refresh_token: No refresh token has been configured yet. Open the app's settings to add one.
